objective: Scale National Outdoor Tools toward 1,000,000 Google Search impressions/day while preserving existing governance.

governance.rule: Scale score prioritizes opportunity only; it never authorizes a build/indexable route or overrides hard vetoes, source/loss/canonical/location-admission/production gates.

engines.name: River Conditions & Forecast
engines.next: Deepen current Rivers with rain/NWPS context; migrate fully to modern USGS APIs.

engines.name: Coastal Water Window
engines.next: Production-verified; expand by meaningful coastal regions/places, not keyword permutations.

engines.name: Smoke / Clear-Air Window
engines.next: Very large surface; unblock AirNow/FIRMS configuration before indexable launch.

engines.name: National Park Conditions Desk
engines.next: Park-by-park decision pages from NPS alerts + NWS + activity-specific conditions.

engines.name: Paddling Conditions Window
engines.next: Activity lens from wind, precip, flow/waves, temp and warnings; no universal safety score.

engines.name: Flood / High-Water Trip Impact
engines.next: NWPS/USGS/NWS synthesis for recreation/travel impact without replacing warnings.

engines.name: Night Sky Clear/Dark Window
engines.next: Deepen existing canonical; combine clouds, darkness, moon and smoke when available.

engines.name: Snowpack & Melt
engines.next: Production-verified; Western mountain + northern snowbelt expansion.

engines.name: Aurora Visibility
engines.next: Continue state/destination expansion only where sky geometry and local context differ.

engines.name: Planting Calendar
engines.next: Connect frost, soil/climate, crop timing and garden decision logic.

engines.name: Bird Migration Intelligence
engines.next: BirdCast + eBird/NWS synthesis; county/metro/destination surfaces with migration timing.

engines.name: Garden Water Stress
engines.next: Extend Garden with rain, drought and conservative watering context.

engines.name: Beach / Swim Decision
engines.next: Use official beach risk plus wave/water-temp context inside Coastal.

engines.name: Frost / Freeze Timing
engines.next: Huge local search surface; city/region pages require climatology + current forecast distinction.

engines.name: Wildfire Trip Impact
engines.next: High-value trip question; blocked by FIRMS + incident/closure normalization.

engines.name: Heat Exposure Window
engines.next: Activity timing using NWS heat products and hourly conditions.

engines.name: Tide / Current Window
engines.next: CO-OPS predictions + observations; strong repeat utility for shore/coastal decisions.

engines.name: Fishing Thermal Habitat Window
engines.next: Water temp/flow/oxygen where measured; no bite-score claims.

engines.name: Trail Surface Transition
engines.next: Mud/snow/freeze-thaw lens; validate before standalone indexed family.

engines.name: Lake / Reservoir Water Temperature
engines.next: Observed temperature + trend + activity context where sensors are defensible.

engines.name: Meteor Shower / Fireball Viewing
engines.next: Combine event geometry with local cloud/moon/darkness; avoid duplicate night-sky canonical.

engines.name: Surf / Wave Recreation Window
engines.next: NDBC/OFS/NWS synthesis; likely lens under Coastal rather than new canonical.

engines.name: Dam / Lock Traffic Arrival Engine
engines.next: Generalize Soo/Melvin Price model where vessel/lock/visitor data are actually available.

engines.name: Fall Color Progression
engines.next: Major seasonal acquisition engine; prioritize regions/destinations with real differentiated signals.

engines.name: Rip Current / Surf Risk Window
engines.next: Keep official NWS risk authoritative; lens inside Coastal.

engines.name: Reservoir Level Recreation
engines.next: Strong demand but fragmented USBR/USACE/state source architecture.

engines.name: Waterfall Flow & Visit Window
engines.next: Scale beyond destinations by linking upstream gauges, rainfall and seasonal normals.

engines.name: Drought Recreation Context
engines.next: Best as context feeding rivers, fire, gardening, waterfalls and parks.

engines.name: Monarch Migration
engines.next: Continue as national migration corridor + regional timing engine.

engines.name: Lake Ice / Freeze-Up / Ice-Out
engines.next: Climatology + observed ice/freeze metrics; never imply ice safety.

engines.name: Harmful Algal Bloom / Lake Impact
engines.next: EPA CyAN + official advisories; health semantics require hard source boundaries.

engines.name: Leaf-Out / Spring Phenology
engines.next: Complements fall color; USA-NPN/temperature-based phenology could create spring counterpart.

engines.name: Deer Rut Timing
engines.next: Enormous search surface; model uncertainty and regional biology need conservative design.

engines.name: Salmon / Steelhead Run Timing
engines.next: Potential multi-region engine; agency/gauge/species data normalization needed.

engines.name: Wildflower Bloom Timing
engines.next: Potentially strong destination intent; needs robust observation/phenology source contract.

engines.name: Tidal Spectacle / Extreme Tide Engine
engines.next: Tidal bores, king tides and special coastal phenomena using CO-OPS astronomy/water data.

engines.name: Elk Rut Timing
engines.next: Expand only around genuine elk destinations/herds with local weather and photoperiod context.

engines.name: Scheduled River Release Engine
engines.next: Generalize Gauley pattern to dam-release recreation events with official schedules/gauges.

engines.name: Eclipse / Solar Event Viewing
engines.next: Massive event spikes but weak baseline; use Night Sky infrastructure rather than standalone strategy.

engines.name: Whale Migration / Viewing Window
engines.next: High travel demand; sightings/forecast sources fragmented by region.

engines.name: Sandhill Crane Migration
engines.next: Strong destination monopolies; limited national surface versus birds generally.

engines.name: Firefly Emergence Timing
engines.next: High novelty and destination value; source/data quality is the limiting factor.

engines.name: Sea Turtle Nesting / Hatching
engines.next: Strong coastal destination intent; official nesting/closure sources vary by jurisdiction.

engines.name: Manatee Aggregation
engines.next: Excellent Florida destination utility but limited geographic scale.

engines.name: Geyser / Geothermal Event Timing
engines.next: Potential high-repeat destination utility; depends on reliable official prediction feeds.

engines.name: River-Rail-Bridge Event Engine
engines.next: Fort Madison-style collision of systems; rare but near-monopoly where data support it.

engines.name: Yosemite Firefall Probability
engines.next: Huge short seasonal spike and travel decision value; narrow geographic scale.

engines.name: Grunion Run Timing
engines.next: California-specific but strong event-decision fit and predictable schedule windows.

engines.name: Moonbow Probability
engines.next: Cumberland Falls-style destination monopoly; highly defensible but narrow.

engines.name: Horseshoe Crab Spawning
engines.next: Excellent tide/moon-driven destination monopoly; small surface but defensible.
